Certified Carpenters - Brisbane    Your new company     Hays Recruitment is currently partnering with reputable construction and building contractors with a strong presence across the region. Due to continued project growth, they are seeking experienced carpenters to join their teams. Known for delivering high-quality residential and commercial projects, these companies value craft skills, safety, and teamwork, offering ongoing work opportunities and a supportive site culture.    Your new role     As a carpenter, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality carpentry work across a diverse range of projects, from commercial fit-outs and office refurbishments through to residential renovations, including bathroom and kitchen upgrades. Your duties will include interpreting plans and specifications, measuring and cutting materials, framing, fixing, installing joinery, and completing finishing work to a high standard.    What you'll need to succeed     
 
 A Certificate III in Carpentry or equivalent trade qualification. 
 Demonstrated experience working as a carpenter on commercial, residential, or renovation projects. 
 The ability to read and interpret construction plans and technical drawings. 
 A current White Card. 
 A valid driving licence and reliable transport. 
 Own tools and PPE preferred. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Competitive hourly rates paid weekly. 
 Opportunities to work on a variety of projects, including commercial fit-outs and residential renovations. 
 Ongoing work with reputable builders and contractors. 
 Support from a dedicated Hays consultant throughout your assignment. 
 
  What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.   The consultants handling these roles are Jarred & Jack in the Hays Mount Gravatt Office.  Please  click here  to apply.
